title: Eastern Fattoush Bread Salad
description: A refreshing salad made with toasted pita bread, mixed greens, and a zesty dressing, inspired by the flavors of the Middle East. Serve chilled for a perfect side dish or light meal.

ingredients.name: Mixed Greens
ingredients.notes: such as lettuce, parsley, and mint

instructions: 2. Cut the pita bread into 1-inch pieces and toast in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
3. In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, toasted pita bread, and chopped parsley and scallions (if using).
4. In a small bowl, whisk together the Eastern-Style Vinaigrette ingredients.
5. Pour the vinaigrette over the salad and toss to combine.
6. Sprinkle the fried capers over the top of the salad.
